lines: “林铮，你不够资格和本皇子称兄道弟，唯有废了你，我才能成为皇朝第一天才。”
“堂哥，别做无谓的反抗，二皇子已经承诺，日后会提携林家，为了家族，你的牺牲又算得了什么。”
“别废话了，废掉他的气海。”
“我来。”
“你们两个杂碎！”
随着冰冷的利剑穿透身体直插气海，强烈的疼痛猛然将林铮从昏死中惊醒。
苍白的脸上布满汗珠，林铮虚弱的坐起身，双拳紧紧握着，指甲刺入肉里都毫不在意。
三日前，湮鼎宗三年一次的考核开始，只要拥有聚灵境修为，不满二十岁的武者都可以前往天梯考核。
林家共十二人有资格，作为皇朝第一天才，巅峰聚灵境的自己当然位列其中。
历经千辛万苦，在他的鼎力相助下，皇子萧焰和林龙双双登上天梯之巅，顺利通过考核。
可就在此时。
两人联手背后偷袭自己，甚至废掉自己的气海，使得灵力消散，从巅峰聚灵境直接跌落到先天境。
同样自己的考核失败。
一个是自己的结拜兄弟，一个是自己的堂弟。
愤怒！不甘！
将自己的兄弟情肆意踩踏，剥夺自己进入湮鼎宗修炼的机会，自己好恨！
砰！
一声巨响，厚重的房门被一脚狠狠踹开。
林虎带着一群凶神恶煞的侍卫冲了进来，第一眼就看到坐在床上的林铮。
“呦？咱们家的天才这是怎么了，你不应该通过考核前往湮鼎宗，怎么还坐在这里，是不是想坐月子。”
“滚？虎少，他竟然让我们滚，哈哈。”
呸！
林虎狠狠呸了一口，大哥今早传回消息，二皇子让自己好好折磨林铮，连一刻都不愿意等，带着人直奔而来。
“气海被废，境界跌落，你已经是个废物，还敢在这里嘴贱，给我将这个废物拖下来狠狠地揍。”
两个侍卫直接走到床边，不管三七二十一，直接将浑身虚弱的林铮拖了下来，丢在地上。
所有侍卫将林铮团团围住。
砰！
砰！
你一脚，我一脚，毫不留情的往林铮身上踹。
“能踹家族的天才，真爽啊。”
“让你平时高高在上，不正眼看我，老子踹死你。”
咬着牙，整个身体缩成一团，硬是一声不吭。
这点痛苦和背叛相比，根本不算什么。
“居然不出声，看来还是不痛，给本少爷继续踹，踹到他跪地求饶为止。”
此时。
挂在林铮脖子上的黑色小塔，正在疯狂的吞食着他浑身流出的鲜血，随即脑海突然传来一道粗狂声音。
‘竟然拥有主人的血脉，小子，只要让弑神塔认你为主，塔爷我就能相助你报仇，杀光这些傻缺’
‘我气海碎裂，境界跌落，你如何助我报仇’
‘你敢质疑塔爷，要不是看在你拥有主人血脉的份上，塔爷才懒得管你，气海碎裂重聚即可，你要是再不让弑神塔认主，你恐怕就真的要跪地求饶了’
疼痛遍布全身，林铮不甘心。
他要报仇！
content_en:
"Lin Zheng, you are not qualified to be my brother-in-law. Only by deposing you can I become the number one genius in the dynasty."
"Cousin, don't resist needlessly. The second prince has promised to support the Lin family in the future. For the sake of the family, your sacrifice means nothing."
"Stop talking nonsense and destroy his Qi Hai."
"I'll do it."
"You two bastards!"
As the cold sword penetrated his body and penetrated into the sea of air, the intense pain suddenly woke Lin Zheng from his coma.
With beads of sweat on his pale face, Lin Zheng sat up weakly, clenching his fists tightly and not caring if his nails dug into his flesh.
Three days ago, the triennial assessment of the Annihilation Cauldron Sect began. As long as they have the cultivation level of the Spirit Gathering Realm, warriors under the age of twenty can go to the Heaven Ladder assessment.
There are a total of twelve people in the Lin family who are qualified. As the first genius in the dynasty, he, who is at the peak of the Spirit Gathering Realm, is certainly among them.
After going through untold hardships, with his great help, the princes Xiao Yan and Lin Long both climbed to the top of the ladder and successfully passed the examination.
But right now.
The two of them teamed up to sneak attack on themselves from behind, and even destroyed their own Qi sea, causing their spiritual power to dissipate, and they fell directly from the peak spirit gathering realm to the innate realm.
He also failed his own assessment.
One is his sworn brother, and the other is his cousin.
anger! Not willing to give in!
I hate it for trampling on my brotherhood wantonly and depriving myself of the opportunity to enter the Diding Sect to practice!
Bang!
There was a loud noise, and the heavy door was kicked open.
Lin Hu rushed in with a group of fierce guards, and the first thing he saw was Lin Zheng sitting on the bed.
"Huh? What happened to our genius? You shouldn't have passed the exam to go to the Diding Sect. Why are you still sitting here? Are you trying to confine yourself?"
"Get out!"
"Get out? Master Hu, he actually asked us to get out, haha."
Bah!
Lin Hu took a deep breath. The eldest brother sent back the news this morning. The second prince asked him to torture Lin Zheng. He didn't even want to wait for a moment and came straight with his people.
"The sea of qi has been destroyed, and your realm has fallen. You are already a waste, and you still dare to talk mean words here. Drag this waste down and beat you severely."
The two guards walked directly to the bed, and without caring about anything else, they directly dragged the weak Lin Zheng off and threw him on the ground.
All the guards surrounded Lin Zheng.
Bang!
Bang!
You kick, I kick, kicking Lin Zheng mercilessly.
"It's so cool to kick the genius of the family."
"If you are always aloof and don't look at me, I will kick you to death."
Gritting his teeth, he huddled up and remained silent.
This pain is nothing compared to betrayal.
"He actually didn't make a sound. It seems that it still doesn't hurt. I will continue to kick him until he kneels down and begs for mercy."
At this time.
The small black tower hanging on Lin Zheng's neck was frantically devouring the blood flowing from his body, and then a rough voice suddenly came from his mind.
'You actually have the blood of your master, boy. As long as you let the God-killing Tower recognize you as its master, I can help you take revenge and kill all these idiots.'
'My Qi sea is shattered and my realm has fallen. How can you help me take revenge?'
‘You dare to question the Tower Master. If it weren’t for the fact that you have the master’s bloodline, the Tower Master would be too lazy to care about you. Just break the Qi Sea and reunite. If you don’t let the God-Slaying Tower recognize its master, you may really have to kneel down and beg for mercy.’
Pain spread all over his body, and Lin Zheng was unwilling to give in.
He wants revenge!
